intro_line: Jeddah: Red Sea gateway where old coral alleys meet modern malls.
intro: Jeddah rewards visitors with historic Al-Balad lanes, a breezy Corniche and superb Red Sea diving. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: No metro yet; a high-speed rail line links Jeddah with Mecca and Medina.
SAPTCO buses cover long-distance routes; city buses are common and timetabled on Google Maps.
Green taxis and ride apps are plentiful; Uber and Careem both work.
Agree the taxi fare before you set off, especially from the airport.
Renting a car is easy; fuel is among the cheapest in the world.
Walking is best in Al-Balad; the Corniche is long, so plan on a taxi.
Boats from Obhur marina are for views, not transport; about SR200 for an hour.

airports.name: King Abdulaziz International Airport
airports.note: Main international hub, about 21 km north of the centre.

options.note: Cheapest option; confirm route and stop locally.
Agree the fare before you set off.
App pickup points are signposted outside arrivals.
Airport has its own station; not all trains call at both stations.
